description: NaTi₂(PO₄)₃ crystallizes in the triclinic P̅1 space group. Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.25-2.66 Å. There are two inequivalent Ti sites. In the first Ti site, Ti is bonded to six O atoms to form TiO₆ octahedra that share corners with six PO₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of Ti-O bond distances ranging from 1.91-2.00 Å. In the second Ti site, Ti is bonded to six O atoms to form TiO₆ octahedra that share corners with six PO₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of Ti-O bond distances ranging from 1.90-2.04 Å. There are three inequivalent P sites. In the first P site, P is bonded to four O atoms to form PO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with four TiO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 27-35°. There are a spread of P-O bond distances ranging from 1.53-1.56 Å. In the second P site, P is bonded to four O atoms to form PO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with four TiO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 24-34°. There are three shorter (1.54 Å) and one longer (1.55 Å) P-O bond length. In the third P site, P is bonded to four O atoms to form PO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with four TiO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 22-31°. There are a spread of P-O bond distances ranging from 1.53-1.55 Å. There are twelve inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a distorted T-shaped geometry to one Na, one Ti, and one P atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Ti, and one P atom. In the third O site, O is bonded in a distorted T-shaped geometry to one Na, one Ti, and one P atom. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a bent 150 degrees geometry to one Ti and one P atom. In the fifth O site, O is bonded in a bent 150 degrees geometry to one Ti and one P atom. In the sixth O site, O is bonded in a distorted T-shaped geometry to one Na, one Ti, and one P atom. In the seventh O site, O is bonded in a bent 150 degrees geometry to one Ti and one P atom. In the eighth O site, O is bonded in a bent 150 degrees geometry to one Ti and one P atom. In the ninth O site, O is bonded in a distorted T-shaped geometry to one Na, one Ti, and one P atom. In the tenth O site, O is bonded in a bent 150 degrees geometry to one Ti and one P atom. In the eleventh O site, O is bonded in a bent 150 degrees geometry to one Ti and one P atom. In the twelfth O site, O is bonded in a distorted bent 150 degrees geometry to one Na, one Ti, and one P atom.
